method: Chop the onion finely, dice the carrot, potato, swede and turnip into 1 inch pieces
Cut the chicken into small pieces and chop the celery finely
Heat some olive oil in a large casserole dish, and add the onion + herbs, salt and pepper
Let the onion get translucent before adding the chicken
When chicken is mostly cooked and simmering in juices add the veggies
Stir often so the veggies dont burn, and when veggies are vibrant add stock and bay leaf
Bring soup to a boil and then let it simmer for 30 mins to an hour
